title: Fishing Rod
description: Every 3 normal combats, upgrade a random card in your Deck.
flavor: Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...
notes: Tracks normal combats. After every 3 normal combats, one random upgradable card in your Deck is upgraded. The relic displays a counter showing (combats seen) mod 3. Only elite and boss encounters are excluded from the combat count.
